guard: `cotal run` refuses an unroutable verb before any plane opens, printing the usage line, and that usage line names every verb the gate routes
proveWith: pnpm mutation-proof --config implementations/runtime/smoke/mutations/run-command-usage.json   # --config resolves against the repo root, never the cwd
why: The unknown-verb case supplies both answer positionals so the hosted answer branch cannot print the same usage line for missing arguments. Invalid JSON stops that wrong path before a broker connection. Removing the verb gate must lose the usage line.

mutations.name: the verb gate is gone, so an unroutable verb reaches answer parsing
mutations.expectRed: and the usage line is printed for it too
mutations.cell: and the usage line is printed for it too
mutations.note: An unknown verb carries complete answer-shaped arguments and invalid JSON. Without the gate it reaches answer parsing, which refuses without printing usage; neither path contacts a broker.

mutations.name: the usage line loses a verb the gate still routes
mutations.note: The two lists drift independently; this is the drift the loop of verb cells exists to catch. Measured 2026-09-03: exactly one red, the `ps` cell, 9 ok, 1 failed. Re-anchored 2026-09-06 when `ps` grew `[--endpoint <ep>]` in the usage line.
